gaps.explanation: Detail records the p4 governmental funds statement 'Transfers in(out)' row gross per fund: General (74,285) + Capital Projects (13,569) + Debt Service (5,985) = 93,839 out, and Cemetery 912 + Fire/Rescue 18,752 + Non major Funds 43,628 = 63,292 in. The Total column prints the net (30,547) (to Water/Sewer, p6 Transfers in (out) 30,547). 93,839 - 63,292 = 30,547; the gap of -63,292 is exactly the intra-governmental transfers in. The Pass-through grant in/out 68,583 (General) net to 0 and are not in this total. Gross vs net only; no error. (Side note: the Water/Sewer detail line from p10 carries label 'Transfers Out' with +30,547; p10 prints it as a transfer in.)

The statement prints p6 Operating revenue 323,454 (accrual). The detail is the p10 cash-basis budget schedule Receipts 'Water and sewer' 327,342 (= p7 Cash received from customers 327,342). The -3,888 gap is the accrual-to-cash difference. The p8 reconciliation shows the decrease in accounts receivable 582, the increase in prepaid water fees 3,881 and the increase in accounts payable 2,045; the report does not split these between receipts and payments. Both printed amounts are correct on their own basis.

The statement total 513,134 (p2) = p6 Total operating expenses 486,906 (incl. Depreciation 81,185) + Interest expense 26,228. The p10 cash budget schedule prints Total 499,329 = Water and Sewer 403,101 (= p7 cash paid 458 + 402,643) + Principal 70,000 + Interest 26,228. Arithmetic: 513,134 - 499,329 = 13,805 = depreciation 81,185 - principal 70,000 + 2,620 (non-depreciation operating expenses 405,721 - cash paid 403,101). Different basis.
